title: LoRaWAN Helium Military IoT Study
text:
LoRaWAN and Helium Blockchain for Military IoT Deployment Security Study.
Key protocol vulnerabilities in LoRaWAN + Helium stack:
- LoRaWAN replay attacks: reuse of captured join request frames
- Join server compromise: root key exposure leads to full network breach
- Network session key exposure: MIC bypass attacks
- Packet forwarder MITM: intercepting gateway-to-server UDP traffic
- Helium validator eclipse attacks: isolating validators from network
- Data integrity failures: unsigned sensor payloads
- Physical layer attacks: jamming, signal manipulation on LoRa frequencies
- Blockchain finality delays exploited for double-spend on IoT payments
Mitigations: frame counter enforcement, mutual TLS, hardware security modules.
Source: ResearchGate 368903469
